posts.title: Clifford Clinton Park!
posts.description: TL;DR: I’m against renaming Pershing Square, but if we had to rename it (which we don’t) let’s name it after Clifford Clinton. Point being, we should name something after Clifford Clinton—a park? a square?—and, below, I make the case as to why Clifford Clinton is so unusually important and uplifting.
